title: Sticker Peel
description: A sticker peel effect lifts the image from a backing: adhesive shine, a die-cut layer coming off the world. Thickness, curl, and glue are the physics, not a still collage of torn paper.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: A corner of the frame rolls. Underneath is another layer or the street.

Use it when identity is something stuck on, and removing it is the beat: titles, a poster, a face as vinyl. It is the wrong tool for a fight, and for a collage that only layers stills without a peel event.
If media collide as equal sources, that is mixed media. If torn paper sits still, that is collage.
This one has a curl and a specular of adhesive.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Build a die-cut layer with paper tooth or vinyl gloss. Animate one peel direction.
Show the adhesive shine on the underside and the backing that is revealed. A hand is optional.
Keep the face or object on the sticker readable. Light the curl with a small hard source so the edge has a tick.
Prompt a sticker peel on the subject: the image lifting from a backing, adhesive shine. For video, a sticker layer peels off, revealing another layer.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Title design and motion graphics are the well-known uses: a credit that is a label, a street-art rip, a vinyl coming off a wall. Grammar of paper as matter, not frames to copy.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a poster in the set. The tell is no curl, no glue, no die-cut edge.
The fix is a lifting layer, adhesive specular, and a reveal underneath.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is sticker peel in film?
Sticker peel lifts the image from a backing like a label. You see thickness, curl, and adhesive shine. The picture comes off the world.
Sticker peel vs collage
Collage stacks stills. Sticker peel is a peel event: one die-cut layer rolling off a backing. One is layers at rest. The other is glue and curl.
When should I use sticker peel?
Use it for titles, identity jokes, a reveal under a poster. Skip it in action that still needs a real room and a real camera path.
How do I prompt sticker peel for AI image or video?
Write Sticker peel on [Subject], the image lifting from a backing, adhesive shine. For video, a layer peels off, revealing another. Name curl direction and backing.
